articles.title: Mary Shelley, writer: "Nothing contributes so much to calming the mind as a permanent purpose, a point on which the soul may fix its attention"
articles.standfirst: The struggle for gender equality in literature reflects the activism of figures such as Mary Shelley, who, facing rejection, created works that continue to challenge patriarchal norms to this day.
articles.summary: The struggle for gender equality in literature reflects the activism of figures such as Mary Shelley, who, facing rejection, created works that continue to challenge patriarchal norms to this day.
articles.body:
M ary Shelley 's work, especially " Frankenstein ," addresses the constant human longing to seek a purpose in life . With the quote "Nothing contributes so much to tranquilize the mind as a steady purpose, a point on which the soul may fix its intellectual eye," Shelley highlights the struggle to find meaning in a world marked by speed and uncertainty. Today, hyperconnectivity and the pressure to be productive make us feel that our lives lack direction, exacerbating a crisis of identity that resonates with the concerns of her characters.

Furthermore, the story of "Frankenstein" reflects the social pressure the individual faces in their search for acceptance . Dependence on others' opinions intensifies in an environment where social comparisons become incessant. Shelley’s critique of individualism becomes relevant, since today we face a constant bombardment of stimuli that can lead to guilt and anxiety . Shelley’s work is not only a science fiction tale, but also a call to reflect on our own inner struggles in a world that never stops demanding more.

The search for purpose in Mary Shelley's work

Mary Shelley (1797-1851) was a British writer recognized mainly for her work "Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus" , considered the first modern science fiction novel. She was born into a family of intellectuals, being the daughter of the feminist philosopher Mary Wollstonecraft and the philosopher William Godwin, which enriched her literary perspective and her treatment of social and political themes. Her writing not only reflects her literary talent, but also the personal struggles she faced throughout her life, making her a significant figure in Romantic literature.

Shelley's thought is immersed in a context of social and political change, marked by the French Revolution and the rise of feminist ideas . Influenced by her mother and father, Shelley used her works to challenge the patriarchal restrictions of her time, highlighting women's experiences and advocating for education and gender equality. Her work "Frankenstein" not only explores creation and responsibility, but also raises profound questions about humanity and scientific progress, themes that resonate with contemporary concerns and with works by other authors of her time, such as Percy Bysshe Shelley and Lord Byron.

articles.title: Prince William reveals he tried to crop Travis Kelce out of his famous selfie with Taylor Swift
articles.standfirst: The Prince of Wales recounted what happened behind the famous selfie taken at Wembley with the singer, George, and Charlotte, without imagining how significant the presence of the Chiefs star would be.
articles.summary: The Prince of Wales recounted what happened behind the famous selfie taken at Wembley with the singer, George, and Charlotte, without imagining how significant the presence of the Chiefs star would be.
articles.body:
Prince William made an unexpected confession about Travis Kelce and Taylor Swift while recalling the famous photograph they took in June 2024, when the Kansas City Chiefs player was backstage during one of the Eras Tour performances at Wembley Stadium.

William had attended the concert with his older children, Prince George and Princess Charlotte, and was able to meet Swift backstage. The group ended up posing for a selfie that also featured Kelce, although the prince has just revealed that he originally had other plans for that photograph.

William wanted a photo without Travis Kelce and tried to crop him out

During his surprise appearance on The Graham Norton Show , the host asked him whether he was aware at the time of how important the image would become. William admitted that he did not understand its significance until much later and revealed, laughing, that he even tried to move the Chiefs tight end out of the frame.

His intention was to get a photograph with only Taylor and her children, but Kelce insisted on returning to the group.

“Travis kept coming back”, William explained when recounting the scene. The prince added that he did not understand why the player kept returning again and again while he was trying to keep him out of the photograph.

The anecdote ended up being especially curious because that selfie had a much greater significance than William imagined. When Taylor Swift posted the image on Instagram, it became the first photograph the singer shared on her main account together with Kelce, making their relationship official on that platform.

Kelce also later recalled that meeting and spoke enthusiastically about having met William and his children. The player even joked about the doubts he had regarding the proper protocol when greeting members of the British royal family.

Taylor Swift and William's history goes way back

The Wembley meeting was not the first time William and Swift crossed paths. The two had already starred in a memorable moment in 2013, during a Centrepoint charity gala at Kensington Palace, when they ended up on stage singing “Livin’ on a Prayer” alongside Jon Bon Jovi.

More than two years after that selfie, the anecdote takes on even more meaning. Swift and Kelce got married on July 3, 2026, at Madison Square Garden in New York, so that Wembley photograph ended up becoming one of the first major public moments of a relationship that ultimately led to marriage.

What William didn’t know at the time was that, while he was trying to get a family photo with Swift, Kelce was starring in one of the most important images in his history with the singer.

articles.title: Sydney Sweeney takes temptation to another level in sheer white lingerie for Syrn
articles.standfirst: The Euphoria star brings a touch of old Hollywood glamour to her latest photos
articles.summary: The Euphoria star brings a touch of old Hollywood glamour to her latest photos
articles.body:
S ydney Sweeney knows how to make a simple white outfit impossible to ignore. The 29-year-old actress appears in a new photoshoot for her lingerie brand, Syrn , wearing delicate white lace that leaves little to the imagination. But there's more to the pictures than a revealing look.

With soft blonde curls, bright red lipstick and a feathered fan, Sweeney brings a touch of old Hollywood glamour to the shoot. The contrast between the romantic white lace and her confident poses gives the photos a playful, seductive feel.

Sydney Sweeney brings romance and confidence to her latest Syrn photos

The outfit features a sheer lace bra, matching thong, long gloves and thigh-high socks. She keeps the accessories simple, letting the delicate fabric and her expressions do most of the talking.

There's something both sweet and daring about the look, a combination Sweeney has embraced throughout her Syrn campaigns.

And these pictures arrive at an important moment for her growing business. Since launching Syrn in January, Sweeney has become the face of her own collections, moving between romantic styles, playful campaigns and more provocative looks.

Sydney Sweeney gives her Syrn holiday collection a Hollywood twist

On October 27, Syrn opened its holiday shop after teasing a collection inspired by classic Christmas movies. The campaign includes playful references to Home Alone and How the Grinch Stole Christmas , with Sweeney transforming familiar holiday scenes into unexpected fashion moments.

Sweeney knows exactly how to catch men's attention while inspiring women to imagine how they might surprise their partners with the right lingerie. And when it comes to representing her own brand, it's hard to imagine a better model than Sweeney herself.

articles.title: Inside Juan Gabriel’s former Florida mansion, now on the market for nearly $39 million
articles.standfirst: The price tag reflects more than the property's famous former owner
articles.summary: The price tag reflects more than the property's famous former owner
articles.body:
A Florida estate once owned by Mexican music icon Juan Gabriel has returned to the luxury real estate market with a $38.9 million asking price — more than 30 times what the legendary singer paid for the property in 1995. Located at 13920 Stirling Road in Southwest Ranches, west of Fort Lauderdale, the sprawling compound covers 9.69 acres and features eight bedrooms, 11 full bathrooms, two half-bathrooms and six separate buildings. The property was listed Oct. 7, 2026, offering a striking example of how a celebrity-owned home can evolve into an ultra-luxury estate.

Juan Gabriel, whose real name was Alberto Aguilera Valadez, purchased the property for $1.275 million when his career was already making him one of the most recognizable Mexican performers in the world. The estate has since undergone extensive renovations and was sold for $9 million in June 2022.

Its current asking price is $29.9 million higher than that transaction, representing an increase of approximately 332%. But the price tag reflects more than the property's famous former owner. The current compound includes a professional-style indoor basketball facility, a private wellness center, a movie theater, two swimming pools and a collection of recreational amenities that make it resemble a private resort.

Inside the 9.69-acre estate

The estate offers approximately 23,442 square feet of space spread across six buildings, with separate areas for living, entertaining, sports and relaxation. The main residence has five bedrooms, each with its own bathroom. Two ground-floor bedrooms feature separate entrances and living areas, while the upstairs primary suite includes a breakfast bar, refrigerator, separate bathrooms and closets, and a balcony overlooking the grounds.

The kitchen is outfitted with high-end appliances from brands including Miele, Viking, Dacor and Liebherr. Additional accommodations include a three-bedroom guesthouse, bringing the property's total to eight bedrooms. The compound also includes a garage with space for four vehicles and lift capacity for up to eight.

Hurricane-impact windows and doors provide an additional practical feature for a property in South Florida , where severe storms are an important consideration for homeowners. A 10,500-square-foot basketball facility is among its standout features

A private resort with a wellness center and movie theater

One of the property's most unusual attractions is its approximately 10,500-square-foot indoor basketball facility. According to Hoodline, the air-conditioned building features professional athletic flooring, locker rooms, a viewing balcony, conference space and a smoothie bar. The facility is currently used by a nonprofit basketball program.

Listing agent Angeline Earnest told the Miami Herald that the current owners, a sports-oriented family, added many of the recreational amenities for their children. The basketball complex is only part of the property's athletic offerings. The grounds also feature outdoor basketball facilities and a hockey area, giving the estate a range of sports spaces rarely found in a private residence.

The additional facilities help explain why the property is being marketed as more than a traditional luxury home. Its appeal extends to buyers seeking a private compound with room for family activities, guests and specialized recreational pursuits. The compound's other buildings offer a variety of entertainment and wellness amenities.

A separate clubhouse features a bar, movie theater and gaming stations. The wellness building includes a sauna, steam room, cold plunge, massage room and tanning bed. Outside, two swimming pools, a tiki pavilion and a koi pond contribute to the property's resort-style atmosphere. Landscaped grounds and walking paths provide additional space for outdoor recreation.

The garage's vehicle-lift system is another notable feature, particularly for collectors who need room for an extensive automobile collection. Southwest Ranches is known for its spacious residential properties, open land and equestrian character.

Located west of Fort Lauderdale , the town offers a different environment from the densely developed waterfront neighborhoods commonly associated with South Florida's luxury real estate market . For prospective buyers, the combination of privacy, acreage and specialized facilities is a central part of the property's appeal.

articles.title: Isabel Allende, writer: "Immigrants always look toward the future, toward what is yet to come"
articles.standfirst: The Chilean writer, recently awarded the Planeta Prize, has made uprootedness one of the great themes of her work
articles.summary: The Chilean writer, recently awarded the Planeta Prize, has made uprootedness one of the great themes of her work
articles.body:
Few voices in Spanish-language literature know as closely what it means to start over in another country as that of Isabel Allende. Born in Lima in 1942, raised in Chile, exiled to Venezuela after the 1973 coup d’état and settled for decades in California, the writer has turned that experience into literary material.

Her reflection on immigration is circulating again these days , just as Allende, 84, has just won the 2026 Planeta Prize with "The Hour Before Dawn," the sequel to "The House of the Spirits."

Isabel Allende, exiled and immigrant

The idea comes from "My Invented Country" (2003), a memoir about Chile in which the author distinguishes between two ways of leaving. As she writes, the exile lives looking back, clinging to his wounds, while " the immigrant looks toward the future , ready to take advantage of the opportunities within reach".

Allende has lived both experiences. "I am an eternal foreigner" , she explained in an interview with the American network PBS, in which she recalled that she was born in Peru , grew up in Chile and was a political refugee before becoming an immigrant. That is why she says she has no roots anywhere.

That journey explains her defense of those who cross borders. In an interview with Telemundo , the writer maintained that " the immigrant contributes to the country much more than they receive " and called for policies that make it understood. Through her foundation she also works with immigrant women and girls.

A Planet with the flavor of return

Her new novel , which will arrive in bookstores on November 4 , brings back Alba Trueba, granddaughter of Esteban Trueba and Clara del Valle, who returns pregnant to the family home after being imprisoned and tortured by the dictatorship. The award , endowed with one million euros , also marks her move to the Planeta publishing house after more than four decades linked to Plaza & Janés.

In the midst of the celebration, Allende has once again looked at the present with concern. Faced with the rise of authoritarianism, she confessed, according to Vía País , that she is once again feeling the same fear that forced her to leave her country.

articles.title: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, philosopher: "Souls act according to the laws of final causes"
articles.standfirst: The search for meaning in the face of uncertainty about the future can find clarity in Leibniz's principle of sufficient reason, who proposed that everything has a logical cause that justifies it.
articles.summary: The search for meaning in the face of uncertainty about the future can find clarity in Leibniz's principle of sufficient reason, who proposed that everything has a logical cause that justifies it.
articles.body:
Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz, in his work "Monadology" , introduces the idea that "souls act according to the laws of final causes." This thought may seem distant, but today hyper-individualism and work pressure demand logical reasoning in our decisions . The constant bombardment of stimuli on social media and the speed of daily life force us to reflect on the motivations behind our actions, something Leibniz advocated.

In a contemporary context of hyperconnectivity, where social comparison and consumerism are predominant, the search for a deeper understanding of our connection with the world becomes increasingly relevant . The dynamics of individualism and the uncertainty we face highlight the need to reconnect with the logical and philosophical spirit that Leibniz explored, facilitating a balance between the self and the surrounding world.

Souls act according to the laws of final causes

The Philosophy of Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz

Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz (1646-1716) was a prominent German philosopher, mathematician, and scientist, known for being one of the greatest thinkers of the 17th and 18th centuries . His legacy includes fundamental contributions to modern logic, metaphysics, and infinitesimal calculus, as well as being an influential defender of pre-established harmony. His quotes, such as "Souls act according to the laws of final causes", reflect his thinking on the nature of the universe and the intrinsic connection between all beings.

Leibniz's thought was pioneering in several intellectual respects , standing out for its concepts of logic, metaphysics, and epistemology. He is considered a precursor of modern logic thanks to his introduction of principles such as the law of identity and the principle of sufficient reason. His theory of monads, which proposes that the universe is made up of simple and indivisible entities that reflect the totality of the world's order, anticipated contemporary metaphysical ideas and was related to other thinkers such as Descartes and Spinoza. Leibniz also discussed the importance of reason in human knowledge, challenging Locke's empiricism.

articles.title: Actor Noah Wyle, chosen as the sexiest man in the world in 2026 by People magazine
articles.standfirst: The 55-year-old star of the series "The Pitt" confessed in an interview with the publication that he thought it was a joke
articles.summary: The 55-year-old star of the series "The Pitt" confessed in an interview with the publication that he thought it was a joke
articles.body:
American actor Noah Wyle has been chosen as the sexiest man in the world in 2026 by People magazine for "his captivating intensity" and his "movie-star good looks," according to the magazine itself.

The 55-year-old star of the hit series "The Pitt" admitted in an interview with the publication upon learning of the recognition that "he couldn't believe it." "I thought it was a joke; I never imagined I would receive such an honor" , he added. "Fortunately, (his wife) Sara, 46, managed to convince him that he did, in fact, meet all the requirements for the title," the magazine explains. " She thinks I'm a good guy, and that the way I am, the father and husband I am, deserve to be recognized, so I thought, "well, if you say so,"" People explains.

Wyle first became known to television audiences as the medical student and later doctor John Carter in the series "ER" ("Emergency Room"), a series in which he worked alongside stars such as George Clooney, Anthony Edwards, Sherry Stringfield, and Julianna Margulies. For his work, he received three Golden Globe nominations and five Emmy nominations during the show's run.

Wyle has returned once again to the hospital world, now as an attending physician, in the role of Dr. Michael "Robby" Robinavitch, in the HBO series "The Pitt", His performance over the two seasons of the series earned him the Golden Globe for Best Actor in a Television Drama Series in 2026, as well as two consecutive Emmy Awards for Best Actor in a Drama Series, in 2025 and 2026. The third season of this successful medical drama is scheduled to premiere in January 2027.

Every year, since 1985, the American magazine has chosen whom it calls the sexiest living man on the planet, a title it has previously awarded to singer John Legend , and actors Michael B. Jordan, Denzel Washington, and Idris Elba , among others.

Kim Kardashian once again captured all eyes with one of her boldest looks. The businesswoman appeared in Mexico City wearing a tight dress by Schiaparelli Haute Couture that left little to the imagination thanks to its figure-hugging design, sheer details, and a plunging neckline.

articles.title: Still Searching for forever? Jennifer Lopez opens up about love two years after Ben Affleck divorce
articles.standfirst: The 57-year-old has revisited the questions that shaped her earlier music while entering a new chapter
articles.summary: The 57-year-old has revisited the questions that shaped her earlier music while entering a new chapter
articles.body:
Finding lasting love has been a recurring theme throughout Jennifer Lopez 's career, but the singer's latest reflections suggest her understanding of relationships has evolved considerably since her separation from Ben Affleck .

The 57-year-old entertainer has returned to one of her most personal musical projects, announcing a deluxe edition of her 2011 album Love? alongside a newly recorded track titled Proof of Love.

During a conversation with Bilt CEO Ankur Jain , Lopez discussed the questions that inspired the original record and how those experiences continue to influence her outlook today.

The album was originally released while she was married to her third husband, Marc Anthony , years before her highly publicized reunion and subsequent divorce from Affleck .

Reflecting on that period, Lopez described it as "a time in my life when I was questioning things and was really trying to figure love out and everything."

Her latest comments arrive during another period of personal change, with both her children having recently left home for college.

The singer's new recording explores the idea that meaningful love isn't necessarily something people can find exclusively through romantic relationships.

Discussing Proof of Love, Lopez explained that "you can really see the proof of love everywhere, but you have to find it within yourself."

The sentiment represents an interesting contrast with the uncertainty surrounding the original album, which was released during a particularly complicated chapter in her personal life.

Lopez has experienced several high-profile relationships, including two separate romances with Affleck , whom she first dated in the early 2000s.

The couple rekindled their relationship years later and married in 2022, before Lopez filed for divorce in August 2024, on the second anniversary of their Georgia wedding celebration.

The singer is also adjusting to a different family dynamic after her 18-year-old twins, Max and Emme, began college.

Their departure marks a significant transition for Lopez , whose career has frequently developed alongside her responsibilities as a mother.

Meanwhile, her renewed focus on music comes as the original Love? album finds another audience.

The record featured On the Floor, her hugely successful collaboration with Pitbull , which has recently experienced renewed popularity after appearing in the television series Off Campus.

Lopez welcomed the song's resurgence, observing that "nothing is old anymore, because people are discovering these things all the time and it's new for them."

JLo looks ahead with new music

The deluxe album is being released through a partnership with financial technology company Bilt, connecting the singer's musical comeback with the brand's November promotional campaign.

Lopez has also continued expanding her commercial portfolio, including a reported $20 million agreement with Italian fashion house Dolce & Gabbana.

Her latest projects demonstrate that her professional ambitions remain substantial, even as her personal circumstances continue to change.

Two years after her separation from Affleck , Lopez appears less interested in presenting definitive answers about romance than in exploring what love means at different stages of life.

Her message is ultimately one of self-discovery, suggesting that the fulfillment she once questioned may begin with understanding herself.

articles.title: Jean Paul Sartre, philosopher: “Man is condemned to be free; because once thrown into the world, he is responsible for everything he does”
articles.standfirst: The famous reflection of the French thinker summarizes the essence of existentialism and continues to challenge whoever reads it
articles.summary: The famous reflection of the French thinker summarizes the essence of existentialism and continues to challenge whoever reads it
articles.body:
There are phrases that outlive their time because they touch on something that never ceases to trouble us. This is the case with one of the best-known ideas of Jean-Paul Sartre , one of the great names in 20th-century philosophy: that the human being cannot escape his own freedom.

The reflection comes from "Existentialism Is a Humanism," the lecture the French philosopher delivered in Paris in October 1945 and which was published as a book the following year. In it, Sartre sought to defend his thought against the criticisms that accused it of being pessimistic and to explain to the general public what existentialism consisted of.

What it means to be "condemned" to be free

The key lies in the paradox. Sartre speaks of condemnation because the human being has not created himself: he does not choose to be born, nor the world into which he appears. However, once he is in it, he can no longer stop choosing. Even not deciding is, for the philosopher, a form of decision.

This idea is based on another of his most famous principles: "Existence precedes essence" . According to Sartre, there is no human nature fixed in advance nor any written destiny. First we exist, and then we define ourselves through our actions. Ultimately, we are what we do with our life.

From this arises the weight of responsibility. If nothing determines us completely, we cannot blame circumstances, education, or character for what we choose. That awareness produces what the philosopher called anguish, and the temptation to flee from it through excuses is what he called "bad faith".

Jean Paul Sartre is the standard-bearer of a philosophy that remains relevant

Far from being a bleak vision, Sartre argued that his philosophy was deeply optimistic, because it places destiny in each person's hands. Moreover, he maintained that in choosing for oneself, one also chooses an image of what the human being should be, which turns every decision into a commitment to others.

Eighty years later , the phrase still resonates in a society that values personal autonomy, but also lives surrounded by options, pressures, and doubts. Choosing a career, a partner, or a way of life can be overwhelming precisely because no one can do it for us.

Sartre, who turned down the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1964 and died in Paris in 1980, thus left one of the most quoted reflections in contemporary thought: being free is not a comfortable privilege, but a task that accompanies human beings throughout their lives.

articles.title: Dick Van Dyke, 100, works out three days a week and has a favorite breakfast: “Coffee with five sugar cubes and two eggs with bread”
articles.standfirst: The Hollywood legend still exercises three times a week, while his wife has shared the unexpected ingredient in his morning coffee
articles.summary: The Hollywood legend still exercises three times a week, while his wife has shared the unexpected ingredient in his morning coffee
articles.body:
At 100, Dick Van Dyke has little interest in slowing down, and his approach to staying active is considerably less complicated than many might expect.

The legendary entertainer, whose career includes Mary Poppins and The Dick Van Dyke Show, remains committed to regular exercise, supported by his wife, Arlene Silver , whom he credits with helping him maintain his physical fitness.

However, while Van Dyke takes his workouts seriously, his morning routine also includes a few familiar comforts, particularly a cup of coffee prepared with five sugar cubes.

Silver previously shared details of her husband's preferred breakfast in an Instagram video filmed after the couple returned from the gym, offering a glimpse into their everyday life.

The meal itself was straightforward with two eggs cooked over medium, toasted potato bread with butter and strawberry jam, and coffee from a Keurig machine.

It was an ordinary domestic moment involving one of Hollywood's most recognizable performers, whose enthusiasm for movement has continued well into his later years.

Regular physical activity has remained a central part of Van Dyke 's routine throughout his life, rather than something he adopted specifically as he grew older.

During an appearance on Ted Danson 's Where Everybody Knows Your Name podcast, the actor reflected on the questions he frequently receives about his remarkable energy.

"Somebody said, 'To what do you attribute your age and physical condition?'" Van Dyke recalled.

"I said, 'I've always exercised.' Three days a week, we go to the gym, still. Three days a week."

His workouts have included stretching, sit-ups and yoga, with an emphasis on remaining mobile and maintaining strength.

Van Dyke believes that consistency has made an important difference, particularly when compared with contemporaries who have become less physically active.

"And I think that's why I'm not stove up like my equals," he explained.

The actor has previously acknowledged that motivation can be a challenge, preferring to exercise early before giving himself an opportunity to reconsider.

Arlene Silver's influence on Van Dyke's daily life

Van Dyke has frequently credited Silver with encouraging his active lifestyle, describing their relationship as a source of companionship and motivation.

The couple met backstage at the Screen Actors Guild Awards in 2006 and married in 2012, developing a shared enthusiasm for fitness and creative projects.

Speaking to Forbes about his wife, the entertainer acknowledged just how important her presence had become.

"I don't think I'd even be here, to tell you that truth," Van Dyke said. "She keeps me in shape, feeds me and I love her more every day. We're just getting closer and closer."

Silver has similarly credited her husband with bringing greater optimism into her life, praising his positive outlook and enthusiasm for ordinary experiences.

Their relationship has become an important part of Van Dyke 's later years, particularly as he continues enjoying activities that have defined his career.

Van Dyke maintains positive outlook after turning 100

Van Dyke has never claimed that one particular breakfast or exercise routine guarantees a long life, instead emphasizing the value of remaining active and engaged.

Even interruptions to his regular gym schedule have proved frustrating, with Silver previously revealing that he became restless when the couple's activities were disrupted during the Los Angeles wildfires.

His determination to keep moving is consistent with a career built around physical comedy, singing and dancing, from his celebrated television performances to his unforgettable appearance in Mary Poppins.

Now celebrating a century of life, Van Dyke continues to find enjoyment in familiar routines, supported by the woman who shares them.

And while his five-sugar coffee might raise eyebrows, the actor's enduring commitment to exercise offers a glimpse into the lifestyle he has maintained for decades.

articles.title: Christopher Lloyd, the legendary Doc from "Back to the Future," confesses his addiction to cocaine: “A couple of lines were all it took”
articles.standfirst: The actor, who has just turned 88, looks back in his memoirs on the years when he used cocaine, alcohol, and marijuana
articles.summary: The actor, who has just turned 88, looks back in his memoirs on the years when he used cocaine, alcohol, and marijuana
articles.body:
C hristopher Lloyd, world-renowned for playing the eccentric Dr. Emmett Brown in the "Back to the Future" trilogy, has decided to share some of the most difficult episodes of his life in his new memoir, ‘In My Own Time: A Memoir’ . At 88 years old, the American actor looks back on his career in Hollywood, but also opens up about a personal period marked by drug and alcohol use that he had until now kept in the background.

In the book, Lloyd recalls how his relationship with cocaine began during the seventies, when he was living in Los Angeles. What initially was a one-time experience ended up turning into an addiction that lasted for years. “A couple of lines were all it took” , the actor admits as he describes the moment when he tried the substance for the first time.

Christopher Lloyd, on the episode that changed his life: “I got hooked almost immediately”

The actor recounts that his first contact with cocaine occurred after leaving a comedy club and approaching the car of a woman he had just met . That night marked the beginning of a habit that progressively increased and to which alcohol and marijuana were added.

“I loved it, and that’s where my cocaine abuse began” , Lloyd writes in his memoirs. The actor admits that, during that period, he did not stop to think about the consequences of his actions. “I didn’t ask myself what it meant or what it gave me. I simply knew that I liked it and, before long, it already had me hooked” , he recalls.

Despite his personal problems, Lloyd assures that he always kept his professional life separate from his addictions and that he never went on stage or stood in front of a camera under the influence of drugs.

One of the most serious episodes took place in May 1984. After returning home and discovering that his partner had locked him out , the actor tried to get in through a window and ended up suffering serious injuries. “The next thing I remember is lying on my kitchen floor, bleeding out, while the paramedics treated me” , he recounts. The blood loss was so severe that he needed a plasma transfusion, as well as surgery and a rehabilitation process to regain mobility in his fingers.

It was not until 1993 that he decided to enter a rehabilitation center, after beginning to work with a psychologist who helped him recognize the harm the substances were causing him. He remained in treatment for five weeks, although the road to recovery was not immediate . “That was the beginning, but not the end” , he admits in the book, in which he also acknowledges having suffered relapses before finally achieving sobriety.

Lloyd's memoir also traces his childhood, his early years in the theater, and the success he achieved with productions such as "Taxi," "The Addams Family," and, especially, "Back to the Future," a saga that made him one of the most recognizable faces in cinema. Now, the actor uses his own story to reveal a much lesser-known side of his life, far removed from the image of the scientist who won over several generations.

articles.title: Patrick Stewart Cause of Death: Legendary "X-Men" and "Star Trek" actor dies at 86
articles.standfirst: The famous actor Patrick Stewart has passed away
articles.summary: The famous actor Patrick Stewart has passed away
articles.body:
S ir Patrick Stewart , the celebrated actor best known for playing Captain Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation and Professor Charles Xavier in the X-Men franchise, has died at the age of 86.

Stewart died at his home in Los Angeles on Wednesday, October 28, according to reports published on Thursday.

A statement shared through his Instagram account revealed that he had experienced a “brief” battle with Alzheimer’s disease and Lewy body dementia.

The announcement brought an end to a career that lasted more than six decades, with the actor earning admiration for his commanding screen presence, distinctive voice and extensive work on stage.

A statement celebrating his life highlighted both his artistic achievements and his commitment to charitable causes.

“His sonorous voice and singular talent will forever be synonymous with indelible performances in every genre. He explored the human condition in all its poetic complexity and brought hope not only to the far reaches of the Marvel Cinematic Universe, but into science fiction’s most iconic final frontier aboard the Starship Enterprise,” the statement read.

It continued: “His professional accomplishments were humbly matched by his philanthropy and activism on behalf of human rights, survivors of domestic violence, global refugees, veterans’ mental health services, and animal welfare, particularly his cherished foster pitties. He was a Knight, Chancellor, motor sport enthusiast, and lifelong Huddersfield Football fan. He will be remembered for the dignity, compassion and humanity he brought to every role — in his art and life.”

From Shakespeare to the stars: The roles that defined Stewart's career

Born Patrick Hewes Stewart in Mirfield, Yorkshire, in 1940, the actor initially established his reputation through classical theatre. He joined the Royal Shakespeare Company in 1966 after beginning his professional career at Manchester's Library Theatre.

For years, he was primarily recognised as a respected stage performer, appearing in productions of Uncle Vanya, A Midsummer Night’s Dream, The Merchant of Venice and Titus Andronicus. His transition into American television transformed his public profile.

In 1987, Stewart began playing Jean-Luc Picard in Star Trek: The Next Generation. His portrayal of the thoughtful, principled captain helped establish the series as a defining chapter in the science-fiction franchise.

He continued playing Picard in several films and later returned to the character in Star Trek: Picard.

Stewart reached another generation of moviegoers in 2000, when he made his debut as Professor Charles Xavier in X-Men.

His character, a powerful telepath and mentor to young mutants, became central to the franchise. Stewart also developed a close friendship with Ian McKellen , who played his on-screen adversary Magneto.

The pair reunited for multiple projects, combining their blockbuster fame with their shared passion for theatre. Stewart also appeared in productions of Waiting for Godot and No Man’s Land with McKellen.

A career beyond science fiction

Although Picard and Xavier became his most recognisable roles, Stewart demonstrated considerable range throughout his career.

He appeared in films including Excalibur, Dune, L.A. Story, Robin Hood: Men in Tights and Green Room, while also lending his voice to animated comedies such as The Simpsons, Family Guy and American Dad!.

His stage achievements remained equally important. In 2008, he won an Olivier Award for his supporting performance as Claudius in Hamlet, starring David Tennant. That same year, he earned a Tony Award nomination for playing the title character in Macbeth on Broadway.

Stewart was knighted in 2010 for his services to drama and became known for supporting survivors of domestic violence, refugees and animal welfare organisations.

He married singer-songwriter Sunny Ozell in 2013, in a ceremony officiated by McKellen . He is survived by Ozell , his daughter Sophie and his son Daniel , from his first marriage to Sheila Falconer .

Stewart's death also comes ahead of the planned release of Avengers: Doomsday, in which he was expected to reprise his role as Professor Xavier alongside McKellen .

His legacy extends far beyond two iconic franchises. Through Shakespearean performances, science-fiction adventures and unexpected turns in comedy, Stewart built a career defined by versatility, dignity and humanity.

articles.title: Zendaya trades the strobe of the paparazzi cameras for high school football
articles.standfirst: The Hollywood star stepped away from the spotlight to support her nephew on the football field, showing a different side of her life
articles.summary: The Hollywood star stepped away from the spotlight to support her nephew on the football field, showing a different side of her life
articles.body:
Z endaya has always made it clear that family comes first . Despite being one of the most recognizable actresses in the world, she makes an effort to stay grounded and be an active , supportive member of her family, even when her career keeps her in the spotlight.

In a May interview with Vogue Brasil, Zendaya explained that spending time with her family helps her maintain a sense of normalcy. She also highlighted how important it is for her to watch her nieces and nephews grow up, a priority she recently put into practice with a casual visit to a high school football game.

The Oakland native went viral after a video showed her attending a game at Folsom High School in Sacramento County. However, she wasn't there as a spectator or simply to enjoy the game. Zendaya had traveled to support her nephew, EJ Coleman, a senior linebacker who had a special reason to be excited about his aunt's presence as he made several big plays on the field.

Zendaya takes her place on the sidelines

The actress attended Folsom's Friday, October 23, matchup against Del Oro High School in Loomis, Placer County. She watched from the sidelines rather than the stands, although she also took a moment to greet the crowd after people noticed she was there. Folsom went on to win a close game, beating Del Oro 42-41.

Coleman later shared a photo with his aunt on Instagram following the game, giving fans another look at their family moment and confirming the reason behind Zendaya's appearance.

Even her game-day outfit had a personal touch

Zendaya didn't leave her fashion sense behind for the occasion . Known for her method dressing at movie premieres, the actress brought that same attention to detail to the football sidelines , putting together an outfit that showed her support for her nephew.

She wore a fuzzy green coat, a custom shirt featuring Coleman and jeans decorated with his name and jersey number . It was a different setting from the red carpets and fashion shows where she's usually seen, but Zendaya made sure her outfit was just as connected to the occasion.

Her appearance was another reminder of how she balances her Hollywood career with her family life , making time to show up for her loved ones even when there's no red carpet or paparazzi waiting for her.
